sources.entry: JetBrains Student Pack: Free access to all JetBrains professional desktop IDEs.

summary.name: JetBrains Student Pack
summary.one_liner: A free-for-students bundle giving access to JetBrains professional IDEs, plugins, and coding courses for the duration of a student's studies.
use_cases: Getting a full IDE for university coursework
Learning a programming language with hands-on courses
Building personal or portfolio projects as a student
Using PyCharm or IntelliJ IDEA for Python or Java assignments
Preparing for tech jobs with coding challenges
summary.what_it_does: Offers free access to around 10 JetBrains IDEs, including full versions of IntelliJ IDEA and PyCharm plus GoLand, PhpStorm and others, for the length of a full-time student's program. Students can alternatively pick a single-IDE option that needs no student verification. The pack also includes JetBrains Academy, a set of hands-on coding courses inside the IDE, and a limited trial of JetBrains AI features such as code completion, AI chat, and an AI coding agent. Access is verified with a university email, ISIC/ITIC card, or GitHub Student Developer Pack, and renews annually through the JetBrains Account.
notable: Full versions of IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, GoLand, PhpStorm and others for free during studies
JetBrains Academy hands-on coding courses inside the IDE
40% off any JetBrains product for two years after graduation
Single-IDE option with no student verification needed
caveats: Licenses are strictly for non-commercial educational use; commercial work needs a paid license
Requires full-time enrollment in an accredited program lasting one year or more
AI features are a limited trial; continued AI use is not described as free
